description: Ratrilig: passes or drops each incoming trigger by chance, with the chance shaped by a three-level grouping of clusters, phrases and cycles

params.text: Sets how many incoming triggers make one cluster, 1 to 32
Sets how many clusters make one phrase, 1 to 32
Sets how many phrases make one cycle, 1 to 32
Sets the chance that a whole cluster is skipped, 0 to 100%; a skipped cluster drops every trigger in it
Sets the chance that a whole phrase is skipped, 0 to 100%; a skipped phrase drops every trigger in it
Sets the chance that a whole cycle is skipped, 0 to 100%; a skipped cycle drops every trigger in it
Sets the base chance that a trigger is passed, 0 to 100%, before the three modifiers and any bias
Sets the spread of the random modifier drawn at the start of each cluster: at 15 the modifier falls between -15 and +15 percentage points
Sets the spread of the random modifier drawn at the start of each phrase, applied for the whole of it
Sets the spread of the random modifier drawn at the start of each cycle, applied for the whole of it
Sets how many percentage points are added to the chosen cluster of each phrase, 0 to 100; at 0 no cluster is biased
Picks which cluster of the phrase gets the bias, 0 for the first and 1 for the last
Sets how many percentage points are added to the chosen phrase of each cycle, 0 to 100; at 0 no phrase is biased
Picks which phrase of the cycle gets the bias, 0 for the first and 1 for the last
Steps the module on when clicked, as an incoming trigger would
Returns the module to the first cluster of the first phrase of the first cycle at the next trigger

inputs.text: Passes or drops each rise to 1V; a passed trigger stays high as long as this one does
Returns the module to the start on each rise to 1V
Adds to the base chance, 20 percentage points per volt over -5V to 5V, with the total held to 0 to 100%
Adds to the cluster modifier spread, 20 percentage points per volt over -5V to 5V
Adds to the phrase modifier spread, 20 percentage points per volt over -5V to 5V
Adds to the cycle modifier spread, 20 percentage points per volt over -5V to 5V

outputs.text: Carries the triggers that were passed, high at 10V for as long as the incoming trigger stays high

notes: a biased cluster or phrase is never skipped, whatever its skip chance says; where both biases fall together the larger is applied in full and the smaller only half
a polyphonic cable on the trigger input runs one independent pattern per channel; a monophonic CV input then applies to all of them, and a polyphonic one is taken channel by channel
the three rings beside the output show whether the last trigger passed, the chance that was applied to it, and the random value drawn against that chance
